title: To Pursue a Woman with Honor: Why Courtship Still Matters
author: Martin, Chris
source: The Ways of a Gentleman, February 19, 2026
summary: Modern dating culture has abandoned the concept of courtship—the disciplined, respectful pursuit of a woman for marriage. Yet courtship represents a man's deliberate choice to honor both the woman he pursues and himself. It requires patience, clarity of intention, and a commitment to restraint and propriety. Courtship is not outdated; it is countercultural and profoundly necessary in an age of casual hookups and ghosting. A man who pursues a woman with honor demonstrates character, demonstrates that he sees her as worthy of respect and commitment, not as a prize to be conquered. Courtship is how a gentleman builds a marriage on a foundation of mutual respect.
points: Courtship is the disciplined, intentional pursuit of a woman with clear marriage intentions.
A man who courtsays honor a woman signals that he sees her worth and respects her dignity.
Restraint and propriety in pursuing a woman demonstrate character and self-command.
Modern courtship is countercultural and radical in an age of casual, commitment-free dating.
quotes: The traditional courtship of decades past might seem like a foreign concept when compared to the modern dating scene.
A gentleman understands that to pursue a woman is to make a statement: that she is worthy of honor, worthy of respect, worthy of commitment.
Courtship is not a romantic relic—it is a framework for men to demonstrate their character and their intentions.” Archived from The Ways of a Gentleman on May 2, 2026 by Tim.
